title: Pre-Registered Experimental Protocol for Conformal Selective Anomaly Detection in Industrial Visual Quality Control
target_journals: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (T-PAMI)

hypothesis.primary_statement: In one-class industrial visual anomaly detection operating under bounded human review budgets (B <= 10%), selective review prioritization driven by calibrated memory-bank boundary proximity—and its local patch dispersion extension—achieves statistically superior defect-escape reduction compared to score-based triaging, while enabling distribution-free finite-sample defect escape guarantees via split conformal prediction.
hypothesis.novelty_barrier: Candidate patch dispersion metrics (CPND) must demonstrate statistically significant improvement (p < 0.05) over the simple distance-to-threshold baseline (21.62% ECR) to justify publication claims.

development_and_calibration.name: MVTec Anomaly Detection (MVTec AD)
development_and_calibration.calibration_split: Nominal Validation Set (N = 419 normal images, zero defectives)
development_and_calibration.qualification: Development-exposed historical baseline; excluded from primary unexposed generalization claims.

primary_unexposed_benchmark.name: VisA (Visual Anomaly Dataset — Zou et al., ECCV 2022)
primary_unexposed_benchmark.exposure_status: UNTOUCHED (0 prior executions in DefectVision AI)

secondary_industrial_benchmark.name: BTAD (BeanTech Anomaly Detection — Mishra et al., IEEE T-II 2021)
secondary_industrial_benchmark.exposure_status: UNTOUCHED (0 prior executions in DefectVision AI)

quarantined_datasets.name: Chukyo Real-World Dataset
quarantined_datasets.status: BLOCKED (Quarantined in cold storage due to 14 identical frame captures)

primary.name: Error Capture Rate (ECR@B)
primary.denominator: Strictly defined as total baseline classification errors (E0 = FN0 + FP0)

baselines.name: Uniform Random Selection
baselines.procedure: Samples k = floor(B * N) images uniformly without replacement; 1,000 resamples

baselines.name: Highest Anomaly Score
baselines.procedure: Ranks images by raw anomaly score S(X) descending (empirically confirmed failure mode)

baselines.name: Conformal Distance to Threshold (Boundary Proximity)
baselines.procedure: Prioritizes samples closest to the calibrated category decision threshold tau_c

baselines.name: Supervised Prediction Margin
baselines.procedure: Upper-bound oracle baseline using supervised classifier probabilities

baselines.name: Calibrated Patch-Neighborhood Dispersion (CPND)
baselines.formula: std_k(distances) / mean_k(distances) for top-K FAISS neighbors
baselines.procedure: Evaluated against BL2 to determine incremental value beyond scalar boundary proximity

calibration_strategy.method: Split Conformal Prediction (Inductive Conformal Risk Control)
calibration_strategy.guarantee: Finite-sample, distribution-free bound on defect escape rate under exchangeability: P(Escape > alpha) <= delta

validation_procedure.split_policy: 5-fold cross-validation on nominal training splits to determine optimal tau_c and neighbor K
validation_procedure.test_exposure_rule: Test splits of VisA and BTAD shall be evaluated EXACTLY ONCE with frozen hyperparameters

statistical_testing.sampling_unit_rationale: In industrial production lines, each arriving item represents an independent inspection event; resampling at the image level captures operational batch variance without assuming Gaussian error distributions.
statistical_testing.significance_test: Two-tailed paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test across all categories with significance alpha = 0.05

failure_analysis.mandatory_inspection: Top-20 defect escapes uncaptured by review budget B = 10%
failure_analysis.collinearity_verification: Pearson and Spearman correlation between 1-NN anomaly score d_1 and proposed dispersion metric PND(X)

computational_budget.hardware_target: Standard x86_64 CPU workstation (no GPU required for evaluation)
